questionText: A particle moves along a straight line with a constant acceleration of 2 m/s². If its initial velocity is 4 m/s, its velocity after 3 seconds is
explanation: Using v = u + at, v = 4 + 2 × 3 = 10 m/s.
subject: Engineering Mechanics

questionText: A force of 10 N acts at an angle of 60° with the horizontal. Its horizontal component is
explanation: Horizontal component = F cos θ = 10 cos 60° = 5 N.
subject: Engineering Mechanics

questionText: A body of mass 5 kg is acted upon by a net force of 20 N. The acceleration of the body is
explanation: Using Newton's second law, F = ma. Therefore, a = F/m = 20/5 = 4 m/s².
subject: Engineering Mechanics

questionText: A 10 kg block rests on a horizontal surface. If the coefficient of friction between the block and surface is 0.3 and g = 10 m/s², the limiting friction force is
explanation: Normal reaction N = mg = 100 N. Limiting friction = μN = 0.3 × 100 = 30 N.
subject: Engineering Mechanics

questionText: A uniform beam of length 4 m and weight 100 N is supported at its ends. The reaction force at each support is
explanation: Since the beam and loading are symmetric, each support carries half the weight. Therefore, reaction = 100/2 = 50 N.
subject: Engineering Mechanics

questionText: A projectile is launched with an initial velocity of 20 m/s at an angle of 30° to the horizontal. Taking g = 10 m/s², the time of flight is
explanation: Time of flight T = 2u sin θ/g = 2 × 20 × sin 30° / 10 = 2 s.
subject: Engineering Mechanics

questionText: A couple consists of two equal and opposite parallel forces of magnitude 20 N separated by a perpendicular distance of 0.5 m. The moment of the couple is
explanation: Moment of a couple = F × d = 20 × 0.5 = 10 N·m.

questionText: A block slides down a frictionless incline of angle 30°. The acceleration of the block is closest to, taking g = 10 m/s²
explanation: Acceleration along the incline is a = g sin 30° = 10 × 0.5 = 5 m/s².

questionText: A 2 kg particle moving at 10 m/s comes to rest uniformly in 5 seconds. The magnitude of the average force acting on the particle is
explanation: Acceleration magnitude = (10 - 0)/5 = 2 m/s². Therefore, force magnitude = ma = 2 × 2 = 4 N.
subject: Engineering Mechanics

questionText: A uniform circular disc of mass M and radius R rotates about an axis passing through its center and perpendicular to its plane. Its mass moment of inertia about the axis is
explanation: The standard mass moment of inertia of a uniform solid disc about its central axis perpendicular to the plane is I = (1/2)MR².
subject: Engineering Mechanics
